bagPolicy.summary: Paramount Theatre sets no bag size limit, but large bags are discouraged and are only let in after a full bag search.
allowed: Bags of any size after a full bag search
prohibited: Outside food and beverages (empty plastic water bottles are allowed)
bagPolicy.note: An artist can request a no bag policy at the last minute, and the venue will enforce it. All guests go through metal detectors. Coat check is on the second floor and only for Broadway performances. Seattle Theatre Group policy applies to the Paramount, Moore and Neptune.

parking.summary: Concerto hasn't confirmed Paramount Theatre's parking details from an official source yet. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

rideshare.note: Use the passenger loading zone at 9th Avenue and Pine Street for drop-off.

concessions.note: Nearby dining options include Palace Kitchen known for its whole trout and burger royale, Etta's Big Mountain BBQ offering smoked meats and cold draft beers, and Serious Pie famous for its pizzas with blistered crusts. Dahlia Bakery is renowned for its Triple Coconut Cream Pie, and Seatown Rub Shack & Fishery serves Clam & Bacon Chowder and Fish & Chips.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Anyone in your party can ask the ushers and security stationed outside (staff dressed in black) for guidance to t he designated accessible entrance of the Paramount Theatre, located on Pine Street at the intersection with 9 th Avenue.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Paramount Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Paramount Box Office is at 9th Avenue and Pine Street and is open Monday to Friday, 10am to 6pm, for advance sales. On show days it opens 90 minutes before showtime for day-of-show needs. Mobile tickets scan from your phone, and barcodes appear 72 hours before the performance.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Front doors open one hour before showtime. The designated accessible entrance is on Pine Street at 9th Avenue, and the ushers and security staff outside, dressed in black, can point you to it.
